title: Typed TABLE list-node capture bounds
mode: Local adapter implementation with generated focused validation
scope: Charge by-value DRW_Table list-node links during dx_iface callback capture.
Keep TABLE snapshot and legacy INSERT projection as separate retained copies.
Verify exact-cap admission and one-byte-over refusal with a locally generated empty TABLE control.
Preserve the reduced fast build and owning-test cadence.

changes.implementation: dx_iface::addTable adds two logical pointer slots for its std::list<DRW_Table> node to the retained estimate before testing the shared typed-entity byte budget. The table-specific and aggregate counters receive the adjusted total. The subsequent INSERT projection remains separately charged by the entity-list retention helper.
changes.generatedControl: The adapter test computes the expected byte total for an empty DRW_Table from its exact inherited/content strings, sizeof(DRW_Table), and two link pointers. It admits at exact remaining shared budget and rejects a one-byte-over attempt before appending the table. Existing populated-table assertions include the link-byte lower bound.
changes.limitations: List links are a logical budget estimate, not allocator-specific node size or process RSS. This does not qualify TABLE format semantics or writer interoperability.

limitationsAndNext: The typed TABLE list-node estimate gap is closed. The current std::list callback stores identified in dx_data, dx_ifaceBlock, block indices, and image indices now have explicit logical link charges. Continue the broader retained container and owner census. The shared worktree remains user-owned and uncommitted; Git metadata is read-only.
